description: Created in the 17th century by Nawab Fidai Khan (architect brother of Emperor Aurangzeb), a magnificent 100-acre terraced garden featuring seven descending canal terraces, Shish Mahal, Rang Mahal, and illuminated fountains.
why_visit: Stroll through seven descending historic stone water terraces, admire illuminated fountains at twilight, and attend the grand annual Mango Mela in July.
best_time_to_visit: Year-round (7:00 AM - 10:00 PM; fountains illuminated evenings)
activities: Mughal Terraced Garden Walking; Palace Architecture Viewing; Fountain Illumination; Mango Festival
distance_from_nearest_famous_place: 20 km from Chandigarh on Shimla Highway
notes: Hosts the celebrated 2-day Mango Mela organized by Haryana Tourism every July.

subcategory: Ramsar Wetland & Winter Migratory Bird Haven
description: A designated Ramsar wetland and national park spread over 350 acres of freshwater marshes, serving as one of Northern India's premier birdwatching havens hosting over 250 bird species including Siberian cranes and flamingos.
why_visit: Spot thousands of colorful migratory waterfowl through high-power telescopes from four watchtowers, walk serene bund trails, and visit the educational bird museum.
best_time_to_visit: October to March (7:00 AM - 4:30 PM, Closed Tuesdays)
activities: Bird Watching; Telephoto Photography; Watchtower Exploration; Wetland Walking
distance_from_nearest_famous_place: 15 km from Gurugram / 45 km from Delhi
notes: Declared a Ramsar Wetland of International Importance in 2021.

description: A 25-acre landscaped urban green park in the heart of millennium city Gurugram, featuring jogging tracks, musical fountains, a rose garden, and open-air concert grounds adjacent to the Kingdom of Dreams.
why_visit: Relax on sprawling green lawns amidst towering glass corporate towers, enjoy morning jogging, and savor street food in neighboring Sector 29 food plaza.
activities: Morning Jogging; Musical Fountain Show; Family Picnics; Dining in Sector 29
notes: Major venue for music festivals, food trucks, and open-air exhibitions.
